name: hitrust-ai-wizard
description: HITRUST AI Wizard v0.1: HITRUST AI Security Assessment (ai2 with r2, ai1 with e1/i1) readiness assistant built on the CMMC Wizard method. Answer the three MyCSF tailoring questions, fill in a web questionnaire for the up-to-44 AI security requirements and their evaluative elements during interviews, then import and review the answers with PRISMA maturity scoring, the 62/83 certification threshold and CAP candidates.
